name: Osapher — Sovereign Identity & Schema
author: c-roc

sections.description:
Osapher connects your WordPress site to your verified business identity — anchored against the Australian Business Register (ABR) and New Zealand Business Number (NZBN) register.

Once connected, Osapher automatically injects your gold-standard JSON-LD schema into every page of your site. This schema tells Google, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Perplexity exactly who your business is, what you do, and where you operate.

Key features:

  • One-click schema deployment from your Osapher vault
  • Automatic injection of Organisation, WebPage, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList and more
  • Live injection log showing schema events and node count
  • AI Visibility Score displayed in your WordPress dashboard
  • Four-pillar Identity Trust Score (ITS): Registry Identity, Schema Quality, Digital Presence, Vault Completeness
  • AI Advisor with actionable recommendations to improve your AI visibility
  • Auto-refresh schema when your vault is updated
  • Supports Australian and New Zealand businesses (ABR + NZBN)

How it works:

  1. Create a free account at osapher.com
  2. Run a Discovery scan on your domain
  3. Complete your Entity Vault with your business details
  4. Deploy your schema from the Vault Deploy tab
  5. Copy your Schema Token and paste it into the plugin settings
  6. Your schema is now live on every page of your WordPress site

External Services

This plugin connects to the Osapher API (https://app.osapher.com) to:

  • Fetch your verified JSON-LD schema payload using your Schema Token
  • Retrieve your Identity Trust Score and AI visibility data for the dashboard

Data sent to Osapher: your Schema Token (used to identify your schema).
Data received from Osapher: your JSON-LD schema payload and trust score metrics.

Osapher Privacy Policy: https://osapher.com/privacy-policy
Osapher Terms of Service: https://osapher.com/terms

No personal visitor data from your WordPress site is ever sent to Osapher.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/verinty-sovereign-schema directory, or install through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Osapher Schema to enter your Schema Token.
  4. Your token is available in your Osapher vault under the Deploy tab.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Osapher account?

Yes. You need a free Osapher account to get your Schema Token. Create one at osapher.com.

Which countries are supported?

Australia and New Zealand. Osapher verifies businesses against the ABR (Australian Business Register) and NZBN (New Zealand Business Number) register.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The schema is cached locally on your WordPress site and only refreshed periodically. There is no performance impact on page load times.

What schema types does Osapher deploy?

Organisation, ProfessionalService, WebSite, WebPage, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, OfferCatalog, Person, and Certification nodes — up to 10 schema nodes per deployment.

Is this compatible with other SEO plugins?

Yes. Osapher schema is injected into the page head and does not conflict with Yoast SEO, RankMath, or other schema plugins.
